hook.name: SatoHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook for ETH/SATO pools that fully replaces AMM execution. Buys mint SATO tokens via a forward curve; sells burn SATO and pay ETH from accumulated reserves. Liquidity additions are permanently forbidden, and the hook acts as the sole counterparty. A block-based cooldown prevents same-block sell-after-buy, and an entropy multiplier applies during the first 100 blocks after deployment.
